name: Forgotten Records
source:
What would you do if you were stuck in an ancient shrine filled with creatures unknown to reality? Forgotten Records is a romance visual novel set in the modern world, where the protagonist wanders into the wrong shrine at the wrong time and has to escape.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4214600/]Steam[/url]]
